CHAOS_HEIDEMARIE_CHARACTER_HEIDEMARIE.de: [b]A hero of the past, and also an idol of the masses.[/b] A hero who distinguished herself during the tragedy of the "Edenity" – the "Elinard" incident. Though she stepped down from her post as an operative due to injury, she continues to enjoy overwhelming popular support, and was propelled into the mayoral office by public sentiment that "we must transcend tragedy and move toward the future."
